method: curated template signatures with aggregate HARP problem/solution support counts
privacy: No problem text, reference solution, or answer is stored in this runtime artifact.

templates.name: Equation substitution and systems
templates.strategy: Name variables, translate every condition, eliminate or substitute, then plug the result into the exact requested target.
traps: Solving for an intermediate variable instead of the requested quantity
verifier_checklist: Substitute the final values into every original equation
Confirm the output is the requested expression, not merely a variable
templates.answer_schema: exact scalar or finite solution set

templates.name: Polynomial roots, factors, and Vieta
templates.strategy: Use factor/remainder theorems and symmetric root relations before expanding; track multiplicity and evaluate only the requested symmetric expression.
verifier_checklist: Verify reconstructed coefficients or substitute candidate roots
templates.answer_schema: number, polynomial, or sorted root set

templates.name: Inequalities and equality cases
templates.strategy: Derive a sharp bound, state the equality condition, and prove that the equality configuration satisfies every domain constraint.
traps: A bound that is not attainable
templates.answer_schema: extremal value plus equality case when requested

templates.name: Functional equations
templates.strategy: Probe neutral and repeated inputs, derive injectivity/surjectivity only when justified, then prove the candidate family satisfies the equation.
traps: Dividing by a possibly zero expression
templates.answer_schema: complete function family with domain restrictions

templates.name: Sequences and recurrences
templates.strategy: Compute small terms, identify invariant or closed form, prove it by recurrence/induction, and check the initial index.
verifier_checklist: Check the first two valid indices
Substitute the closed form into the recurrence
templates.answer_schema: exact term, recurrence, or proved closed form

templates.name: Rational expression simplification
templates.strategy: Factor completely before cancellation, record excluded values, and verify the simplified form symbolically or at safe sample points.
verifier_checklist: Compare domains before and after simplification
templates.answer_schema: simplified exact expression with exclusions if requested

templates.name: Ratios, proportions, and percentages
templates.strategy: Represent ratio parts with one scale variable, distinguish percent change from percentage points, and preserve the requested units.
templates.answer_schema: exact rational, percentage, or quantity with units

templates.name: Rates, work, motion, and mixtures
templates.strategy: Choose a conserved quantity, build a rate-time table, align time intervals, and solve with consistent units.
traps: Adding times when rates should add
verifier_checklist: Recompute total distance/work from the candidate
templates.answer_schema: nonnegative scalar with units

templates.name: Modular arithmetic and periodicity
templates.strategy: Reduce early, identify periods or invertible factors, solve residue classes, then enforce original bounds and sign conventions.
traps: Dividing by a nonunit modulo n
templates.answer_schema: least nonnegative residue or complete congruence class

templates.name: Prime valuations, gcd, and lcm
templates.strategy: Work prime by prime, translate gcd/lcm into min/max exponents, and rebuild the integer only after all valuations are settled.
verifier_checklist: Compare both sides at an arbitrary prime
Check primes absent from some factors
templates.answer_schema: integer, factorization, or valuation identity

templates.name: Diophantine equations
templates.strategy: Use congruences, gcd constraints and factorization to bound the integer search; prove the resulting case list is exhaustive.
traps: Counting ordered versus unordered pairs incorrectly
verifier_checklist: Prove exhaustiveness from bounds or factor pairs
templates.answer_schema: sorted finite set or requested count

templates.name: Digits and numeral bases
templates.strategy: Expand place values explicitly, impose digit ranges and leading-digit constraints, then use congruences to reduce cases.
verifier_checklist: Check every digit lies in the base range
templates.answer_schema: integer, digit tuple, or count

templates.name: Similarity and congruence
templates.strategy: Write an explicit correspondence before using ratios; propagate directed angles and verify all lengths are attached to matching sides.
traps: Assuming the diagram is to scale
templates.answer_schema: positive exact length, ratio, angle, or proof

templates.name: Circles, tangency, and power of a point
templates.strategy: Identify cyclic quadrilaterals and equal powers, use directed angles, and choose the correct secant/tangent segment convention.
traps: Using whole versus external secant length incorrectly
verifier_checklist: Check power products use the correct segments
templates.answer_schema: positive exact length, angle, power, or proof

templates.name: Coordinate and vector geometry
templates.strategy: Choose symmetry-aware coordinates, encode incidence/perpendicularity algebraically, solve, then discard branches violating geometry.
verifier_checklist: Substitute coordinates into every incidence condition
templates.answer_schema: coordinate tuple, exact length/slope, or proof

templates.name: Area, volume, and decomposition
templates.strategy: Decompose into nonoverlapping pieces or use invariant area ratios; keep length, area and volume scaling powers distinct.
traps: Using slant instead of perpendicular height
templates.answer_schema: nonnegative exact measure with square/cubic units

templates.name: Casework, bijections, and symmetry
templates.strategy: Define the counted object, split into disjoint exhaustive cases or construct a bijection, and divide by symmetry only after stabilizers are understood.
verifier_checklist: Prove cases are exhaustive and disjoint
templates.answer_schema: nonnegative integer count

templates.name: Complement and inclusion-exclusion
templates.strategy: Count the clean universe, define bad events precisely, and apply complement or inclusion-exclusion with intersections indexed consistently.
verifier_checklist: Ensure result lies in valid count/probability range
templates.answer_schema: nonnegative integer or reduced probability

templates.name: Combinatorial recurrence and state DP
templates.strategy: Choose a minimal state that records future-relevant information, derive transitions, and establish all base cases before evaluating.
verifier_checklist: Check every object has one predecessor transition
templates.answer_schema: nonnegative integer sequence value

templates.name: Double counting and invariants
templates.strategy: Define one finite incidence set and count it in two ways; for processes, identify a quantity preserved or monotone under every move.
traps: Counting different universes on two sides
Claimed invariant changes in an edge case
verifier_checklist: Check the contribution of one object from each side
templates.answer_schema: integer identity, divisibility statement, or proof

templates.name: Finite probability and conditional counting
templates.strategy: Specify equally likely atomic outcomes, count numerator and denominator under the same labeling convention, then reduce the fraction.
verifier_checklist: Reduce and perform requested numerator/denominator postprocessing
templates.answer_schema: reduced rational probability or requested derived integer

templates.name: Expectation and indicator variables
templates.strategy: Define indicator variables for atomic contributions and use linearity before attempting a full distribution; condition only when it simplifies dependencies.
traps: Confusing expected ratio with ratio of expectations
verifier_checklist: Bound the expectation by the possible range
templates.answer_schema: exact rational or real expectation

templates.name: Trigonometric identities and equations
templates.strategy: Normalize angles, reduce to a small identity set, preserve quadrant/sign information, and enumerate all solutions in the requested interval.
verifier_checklist: Substitute solutions into the original equation
templates.answer_schema: exact trig value or sorted solution set

templates.name: Complex numbers and polar form
templates.strategy: Choose rectangular or polar form based on the operation, track all arguments/roots, and translate the requested component at the end.
verifier_checklist: Check root count and angular spacing
templates.answer_schema: exact complex expression, component, or complete root set

templates.name: Contradiction and minimal counterexample
templates.strategy: Negate the exact conclusion, preserve all quantifiers, derive a concrete violation, and identify the line that closes the contradiction.
verifier_checklist: Check the negation is logically exact
Identify where each hypothesis is used
templates.answer_schema: complete proof

templates.name: Induction and strengthening
templates.strategy: Choose the correct induction parameter, prove all required base cases, and strengthen the statement if the step needs additional structure.
traps: Induction cannot reach every residue class
verifier_checklist: Mark the exact use of the inductive hypothesis
templates.answer_schema: complete proof

templates.name: Extremal principle and invariants
templates.strategy: Select an extremal object or a discrete invariant/monovariant, prove it behaves under every allowed operation, then derive termination or impossibility.
verifier_checklist: Connect the invariant to the stated conclusion
templates.answer_schema: complete proof

templates.name: Pigeonhole and averaging
templates.strategy: Define pigeons and holes so that a collision has exactly the desired meaning; use averaging when contributions have weights.
verifier_checklist: Translate one collision back to the original objects
templates.answer_schema: existence proof or extremal integer
